failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query hop 2: 'What instruments does Leafcutter John play in Polar Bear, and did Polar Bear release an album called "Same as You"?' Query hop 3: 'Is Leafcutter John a member of the British experimental jazz band Polar Bear, and did that band release an album titled "Same as You"?' Both queries ask essentially the same question about Leafcutter John's membership in Polar Bear and the Same as You album, despite summary_1 and summary_2 both confirming the claim is already verified. The queries fail to advance beyond re-asking already-answered questions.
